_about: Story progress for Bible Stories. The weekly run reads this to know what is done and what comes next, and updates it after each release. Shelf data shown on the site lives in js/stories.js; chapter sources in tools/stories/<id>.js; the leaderboard list in netlify/functions/leaderboard.mjs (STORIES).

weekly_plan.volume: 4 new characters a week, chapters to fit each story (up to 4, never padded) - Dawn, Nov 27 2026
weekly_plan.release_day: Monday; the week runs Monday-Sunday CT, like the Weekly Scheduler
weekly_plan.auto_go_live: yes, once all three checks pass (Dawn, Nov 27 2026)
weekly_plan.first_release: the first Monday after the waiting batch goes live (Dawn: stories start next week, on a Monday)

next.title: (to name) brothers come to Egypt, Joseph makes himself known
(to name) Jacob goes down to Egypt; God meant it unto good

joseph.note: Genesis 38 is about Judah, not Joseph, so it is not one of the Joseph chapters.

christmas.content_choices: no wings on angels, no star over the manger, no donkey or stable animals (not in the text), the wise men visit a house (Matthew 2:11), their number is not given in Scripture

returning_characters: A character can come back in a later week with new chapters that continue the story (for example David's later years, Paul's journeys).
